maria: Hey team  please welcome Priya Shah who starts today on Eng-SRE! She'll be focusing on infra observability and alerting. :tada:
priya shah: hi all, excited to join! quick q: who should I DM about a work laptop and building access?
ben: welcome @priya! tag @elaine for badge + building access. For laptop preference, fill the hardware form in Notion (pinned in #new-hires) or DM me if you need a specific image.
priya shah: thanks @ben. I'm fine with mac but might need a linux VM for some debug tooling.
elaine: @priya I scheduled a badge pickup for tomorrow 9:30am and sent a calendar invite. Also added you to the "sre-oncall" google group.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist updated: "Priya Shah" added to Slack, Google Workspace, and GitHub teams. Pending: 2FA setup, laptop assignment.
priya shah: seeing the GH invite now, thanks. tiny fun fact: I bake challah every Friday morning. :bread:
maria: love a baker on the team. we'll have to schedule a snacks day. Welcome again @priya!
ben: if you want a tiny starter task, there's a low-risk alert-rule doc review I can assign. no pressure.
priya shah: happy to take that on. thanks everyone! :wave:
